provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Castles of Burgundy rulebook (alea / Ravensburger, via RulesPal)

steps.text: 24 silver coins, 26 worker chips and the white die next to the board
Hex tiles sorted by back color in facedown piles
Shuffle the 42 goods tiles: 5 facedown stacks of 5 on phase spaces A-E; the other 17 aside
The 12 bonus tiles on their spaces (big on top of small)
Each player: a player board (all the same number, 1 or 2) and an overview board
Your castle on the dark green 6 in the center of your board
{n} random goods tiles from the 17, faceup on your storage (stack same colors); box the rest
2 dice of your color, 1 silver coin on your board, a 100/200 victory point tile
One playing piece on 0 of the victory point track
Roll for starting player; workers by turn order: 1, 2, 3, 4
Second playing pieces stacked on space 1 of the bridge, starting player on top; they take the white die
Phase A: lay out its goods and hex tiles, then everyone rolls
